skill.name: cc-skill-strategic-compact
skill.description: Adds a Claude Code hook helper that suggests manual context compaction after tool call milestones.
skill.summary: Suggests strategic compact checkpoints during long Claude Code sessions.
skill.author: affaan-m

security_audit.summary: The skill is a small Bash hook helper that prints compact reminders during long Claude Code sessions. No prompt injection or network behavior was found, but the script executes through a hook and uses a predictable temporary counter file.

remediation.suggestion: Use mktemp or XDG_RUNTIME_DIR with user-only permissions, validate the counter as numeric, and clean up stale state.
Keep hook installation manual and explicit, document when the script runs, and avoid enabling hooks during automated installation.

finding_verdicts.reason: The command substitution invokes a fixed cat command against a quoted local path, not a user-controlled command string. The broader temporary file risk is covered by the temp-directory finding.
This line increments a numeric counter with Bash arithmetic and does not launch an external command. Malformed file content could cause an error, but it is not command execution.
This condition uses Bash arithmetic to test the local counter modulo 25. It does not evaluate a dynamic command or execute user-supplied shell text.

The skill includes a Bash script intended to run from a Claude hook, so enabling it executes local shell code in the user's environment. The observed behavior is limited, but shell execution is a real permission boundary.
The ~/.claude/settings.json path appears only in a commented hook configuration example. The script does not read from or write to that hidden home directory path.
The ~/.claude/skills path is shown as a commented command location in sample configuration. It is not active filesystem access by the script.
This is documentation text in a comment, not a file access operation. No code on this line opens, modifies, or creates a hidden file.
This commented example references where a user could place the script. The active code does not access the hidden path.

The script stores state in /tmp using a predictable process-id based name and later reads and writes that path. Without mktemp, ownership checks, or numeric validation, a local user could tamper with the counter path.

semantic_findings.title: Automatic Hook Execution Surface
semantic_findings.description: The sample configuration wires the script into a PreToolUse hook for Edit and Write actions, which would run it automatically when those tools are used. The script appears benign, but marketplace installation must not silently enable this behavior.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Lines 14-18 show a command hook configuration that invokes this script on tool use. There is no malicious payload, but automatic local shell execution is a clear security surface.

content.value_statement: Long Claude Code sessions can lose focus when automatic compaction happens at awkward times. This skill provides a hook helper that suggests manual compaction at tool call milestones.
actual_capabilities: Provides a Bash hook script for PreToolUse events.
Counts tool invocations using a temporary state file.
Reads COMPACT_THRESHOLD to customize the first reminder.
Prints compact reminders to stderr at threshold milestones.
Includes example Claude hook configuration comments.
limitations: The bundled README gives minimal usage guidance.
The counter file uses the process ID, so counts may reset between hook executions.
It does not compact sessions automatically.
It depends on Bash and Claude hook support.

use_cases.title: Plan a long refactor
use_cases.description: A developer wants reminders to compact after extended edit sessions.

use_cases.title: Coordinate milestone handoffs
use_cases.description: A lead uses manual compaction checkpoints before switching from research to implementation.

use_cases.title: Tune local workflow hooks
use_cases.description: A power user adjusts the compact threshold to match preferred session length.

prompt_templates.title: Enable Basic Reminders
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me decide whether to enable the strategic compact hook for a long Claude Code session.

prompt_templates.title: Set a Threshold
prompt_templates.prompt: Recommend a compact reminder threshold for a session that will include research, edits, and tests.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Phase Checkpoints
prompt_templates.prompt: Create compact checkpoints for my current Claude Code task: exploration, implementation, verification, and final handoff.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Hook Usage
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my planned Claude hook configuration for this skill and identify safety, reliability, and consent concerns before I enable it.

output_examples.input: User asks when to compact during a long refactor.
output_examples.output: Suggested compact points after research, before broad edits, after tests, and before switching tasks.

output_examples.input: User wants to change reminder frequency.
output_examples.output: Recommendation to raise or lower the threshold based on session length and tool call volume.

output_examples.input: User reviews hook safety before enabling it.
output: Check how the temporary counter file is stored.

best_practices: Enable the hook only after reviewing the script and understanding when it runs.
Set a threshold that matches your normal session length.
Treat compact reminders as prompts for judgment, not automatic workflow decisions.
anti_patterns: Do not enable hooks from community skills without reading their commands.
Do not rely on this helper as a substitute for task summaries.
Do not store sensitive workflow state in shared temporary locations.

faq.question: Does this skill run commands?
faq.answer: Yes. The included Bash script runs when a user configures it as a Claude hook.

faq.question: Does it send data over the network?
faq.answer: No evidence found in the reviewed files for network requests or remote data transfer.

faq.question: Does it compact automatically?
faq.answer: No. It prints reminders so the user can decide when to compact.

faq.question: Which tools does it support?
faq.answer: It is marked compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code, but the hook example targets Claude Code.

faq.question: Can I change the reminder threshold?
faq.answer: Yes. Set COMPACT_THRESHOLD in the environment before running the hook.

faq.question: What should I review before enabling it?
faq.answer: Review the Bash script, the hook trigger, and the temporary file behavior.
